display.purpose: Today's click count, the single large figure in a clicks panel.

headline.purpose: Page titles and the sign-in card title.

subhead.purpose: Section headings above a group of panels.

body.purpose: Default text. Stylistic set 1 ('ss01') is on for all Golos Text.

body-sm.purpose: Table cells, inputs, sentences inside panels, menu items.

control.purpose: Button and nav labels. Small buttons use 0.8125rem, large 0.9375rem.

label.purpose: Field labels, segments, tag toggles; hints and meta lines at weight 400.

sign.purpose: Table column headers only. Uppercase, in Station Bronze (#8c5d28).

code.purpose: Short codes, the url.mekhroj.com/ host prefix, click timestamps. Host in Ink 3, code in Ink.

code-specimen.purpose: A link's short code set large on its own page; host prefix at 1.125rem in Ink 3.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: The single creation surface on a page: the ticket window on the dashboard and the sign-in card.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Floating layers: dialogs, the account menu, the chart tooltip, toasts, the sticky bulk-action bar.

shadows.name: segment-selected
shadows.purpose: The white selected segment inside the marble trough of a segmented control.

shadows.name: nav-active-underline
shadows.purpose: Bronze rule under the current page in the top bar.

shadows.name: station-halo
shadows.purpose: White halo around a station disc so it cuts the line behind it.

shadows.name: station-expiring
shadows.purpose: Extra warn ring on a station whose link expires within a week.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing curve, used for every state change.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background changes on hover and press; tooltip fade.

motion.name: t-base
motion.purpose: Station scale on highlight, stale-data dimming, dialog and toast entrance.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: A new link's station scales in from 0.3 with a fade; the create form's confirmation strip slides 4px. The one authored moment.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Skeleton rows on first load only.

breakpoints.name: dashboard-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column panel rows stack; three-column rows become two.

breakpoints.name: table-wide
breakpoints.purpose: Links table hides its lowest-priority columns.

breakpoints.name: detail-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Link page panel grid becomes one column.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Top bar nav collapses to a menu button, Shorten shows its icon only, create form stacks, page padding drops to 16px.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Line map labels stack above tracks and stations narrow to 72px; code rows stack.

containers.name: manage-page
containers.purpose: Collections, tags, invites and settings pages.

narrative.overview:
Bekat treats a set of short links as a metro network. Collections are lines, each with its own colour; links are stations along them; clicks are passengers through the turnstiles. The materials are those of a Tashkent Metro station: a polished granite top bar, a cool marble floor, white platform panels edged with hairline stone, bronze station lettering, and one band of glazed ceramic tile. The line colours are the brightest colours in the interface, and apart from the tile band they always mean a collection or a tag.

The interface is an operating tool, not a showcase. Density is moderate and even: 36px controls, 12px table cell padding, panels on a 20px grid gap, a 1360px page. Standard web controls are used throughout; the world contributes the palette, the two typefaces, the density and one signature component, the line map. Motion is short and confined to state changes. Page content does not animate in on load.

The world rejects the category default of a grey sidebar, a blue accent, rows of stat tiles and a lone line chart. Navigation sits in a horizontal granite bar, interface accents come from granite and bronze, and the clicks chart is a bar strip in granite with today's bar in bronze.
keyCharacteristics: Granite top bar over a marble ground; white panels with 1px stone borders and no resting shadow.
Seven line colours reserved for collection and tag identity, assigned in a fixed order.
Bronze for signage: station codes on the line map, table column signs, the spike annotation, link underlines, the wordmark marker.
Golos Text for the interface; Red Hat Mono for short codes, the short-link host and click times.
One ornament: a single 18px ceramic tile band under the top bar.
The line map: collections drawn as 4px coloured lines with links as white stations sized by clicks.
150 to 200ms ease-out on state changes; one 240ms arrival when a new link is created.

rules.name: The Line Colour Rule
rules.body: Line colours mean a collection or a tag and nothing else. Buttons, links, focus rings, selection, charts and status never use them. The ceramic tile band is the one place they appear as ornament, and it repeats all six in their fixed order.

rules.name: The Fixed Order Rule
rules.body: Line colours are offered and assigned in the order red, blue, green, violet, amber, teal, with slate for no collection. The order is part of the identity; do not reshuffle it per screen.

rules.name: The Bronze Split Rule
rules.body: Bronze text uses Station Bronze (#8c5d28, 5.7:1 on white). Bronze Rule (#a26f35, 4.3:1 on white) is for lines, underlines and marks only.

rules.name: The Quiet Health Rule
rules.body: A healthy link shows no badge. Status colour appears only when a link is paused, expired, expiring within a week or in error.

rules.name: The Code Face Rule
rules.body: Anything a person would type after the slash, and the host before it, is set in Red Hat Mono. Everything else is Golos Text.

rules.name: The Signage Rule
rules.body: Uppercase, letter-spaced bronze labels are column signs in table headers. They are not used as headings or as labels above headings.

rules.name: The Flat Platform Rule
rules.body: Panels rest flat on the marble with a stone hairline. Only the page's single creation surface is raised, and only overlays cast the overlay shadow.

dos: Do use Polished Granite (#2a2d33) for every interface accent that is not identity: primary buttons, chart bars, share bars, tooltips, toasts, focus rings.
Do show a collection or tag as a line dot (10px, 7px in chips) or a 4px line in its line colour, next to its name in text.
Do set short codes, the host prefix and click times in Red Hat Mono, with the host in Ink 3 and the code in Ink.
Do separate panels from the marble ground with a 1px Stone (#d5d9df) border, and rows inside panels with 1px Marble Sunken (#e3e6ea).
Do keep state transitions at 150 to 200ms on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and respect reduced motion.
Do pair every status colour with an icon and a word.
Do dim stale data to 60% while it refetches rather than flashing a skeleton.
Do keep creating a link one step away: the Shorten button in the top bar on every signed-in page.
donts: Don't use a line colour for a button, link, focus ring, chart bar or status.
Don't add a second ceramic band or any other ornament; the tile band under the top bar is the only one.
Don't set text in Bronze Rule (#a26f35); bronze text is Station Bronze (#8c5d28).
Don't put a shadow on a resting panel; Raised is for the single creation surface, Overlay for floating layers.
Don't use uppercase letter-spaced signage outside table column headers.
Don't add entrance animation to page content on load; panels and rows appear without motion.
Don't show a badge on a healthy link.
